spans.s: 1. रि रि, i. 6, रिय, Par. To go.
2. रि रि, ii. 5, v. r. for ऋ, ii. 5, To hurt.

. To go.
 2. To howl.
 3. To hart.

2. री री, i. 4, Ātm. To distil, to ooze, to drop.
 --With the prep. अनु अनु, To drop after, to follow dropping,

= Rigv. i. 85, 3.
 --Cf. Goth. and A.S. rinnan (based on ii. 5).
